newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel wins Lyonnaise telephone deal.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel wins Lyonnaise telephone deal.

text.p: French cable company operator Lyonnaise Cable, a unit of Lyonnaise des Eaux, has chosen the telecoms division of Alcatel Alsthom to supply the first fixed-telephone network to be used over cable television in Europe, Alcatel announced on Monday.
Business and residential users in Annecy region will be the first in Europe to have a multi-service range -- television, telephone including ISDN and Internet access -- over the same network.
These services will be extended to other sites beginning on January 1, 1998 when the telecommunications market is fully opened up to competition.
Alcatel will install and integrate the network.
Alcatel gave no value for the contract in the statement.
